execution.instructions: Use the selected Agent Caravan execution profile and preserve its role, handoff, approval, and termination boundaries.

execution_projection.workflow_construct: one coordinating runtime task with explicit stage checkpoints
execution_projection.role_construct: runtime instructions and skill/tool lanes selected by the orchestrator

execution_projection.approval_construct: Codex tool approval gates and explicit human confirmation points
execution_projection.degraded_behavior: follow the execution profile topology; use declared serial fallback when optional parallel lane execution is unavailable; do not simulate native subagents

fallback_rules: run profile-authorized optional parallel lanes serially in the declared order when parallel lane execution is unavailable
